notes.title: DevGAMM Community Vote: Help Crabby Fishes Win (ends Oct 5)
notes.content:
Community, we need your help! 


The DevGAMM Community Vote is live - please vote for Crabby Fishes.


How to vote (~30s):
[olist]
Open: https://devgamm.fillout.com/community-vote2025

Search/select Crabby Fishes

Submit (1 email = 1 vote)
[/olist]
Deadline: Oct 5. Thank you! 🦀

notes.title: Demo Update is live!
notes.content:
Quick note on what’s new in the Crabby Fishes demo:



UI & Clarity

Refreshed interface for cleaner visuals

Clearer in-game messaging and feedback

Inventory tweaks for better readability and item info

Game Design

Rebalanced waves and enemy pacing

Adjusted tower stats, costs, and ranges

Tuned Special Power cooldowns & impact

Smoother early difficulty curve and rewards

Content

New enemy units added

New towers to experiment with

New Special Powers to shake up your strategies

Jump in, give it a spin, and let us know what you think in the Community Hub discussions - your feedback helps us polish the full release!
